needs.GOOGLE_MERCHANT_CLIENT_ID: the OAuth 2.0 client ID for a Google Cloud project with the Merchant API enabled
needs.GOOGLE_MERCHANT_CLIENT_SECRET: the OAuth 2.0 client secret paired with GOOGLE_MERCHANT_CLIENT_ID
needs.GOOGLE_MERCHANT_REFRESH_TOKEN: an OAuth refresh token granted the https://www.googleapis.com/auth/content scope by a user with access to the Merchant Center account
